test_assert_allclose: test the assert_allclose function to compare two PyTorch tensors with configurable absolute and relative tolerances
build_construct_fp8_attention_inputs: build FP8 attention inputs for Triton Split-k benchmarks with fused row-wise dequantization and paged K/V cache
test_quantize_fp8_asymmetric: test the quantize_fp8_asymmetric function to quantize a PyTorch tensor to FP8 with asymmetric per-row scaling
test_dequantize_fp8_asymmetric: test the dequantize_fp8_asymmetric function to convert an FP8 tensor back to full precision using scale and shift
test_disable_tf32: test the disable_tf32 decorator to temporarily disable TF32 in cuDNN and cuBLAS during a function call
